name: ai-visibility-audit
description: Audits an online store's readiness to be discovered, cited, and recommended by AI chat assistants and shopping agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Combines a live technical probe of the public website with internal data from every connected source — Mergado, Google Merchant Center, Search Console — into a single fixed-format report.
